**Easier recipient management, richer newsletters, and a new Logs page**

- **Bring your people in faster.** Import recipients from a pasted list or a CSV, or straight from your Plex or Tautulli users, and manage group membership right from the recipient's edit dialog. The Recipients page is now a searchable, sortable table.
- **Say more in each newsletter.** Add an intro note, a footer note, and up to four buttons (for example, a link to your Plex app). The default template also has larger, easier-to-read text, and you can pick its font.
- **See what happened.** Send history now shows who each newsletter went to, what it included, and a copy of what was sent. A new Logs page shows recent server activity without needing `docker logs`.
